source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 632 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 632 was established by Ordinance No. 25252, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 14, 2003. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 632 is established on property generally located along the east line of Pierce Street south of Glenfield Avenue. The size of PD 632 is approximately 18.543 acres. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 632A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 632B). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) The owner of the Property shall submit a copy of each proposed development plan, landscape plan, or amendment to those plans, including proposed minor amendments pursuant to Section 51A-4.702(h), to the Southwest Dallas Neighborhood Association at the address most recently furnished to the owner in writing by the Southwest Dallas Neighborhood Association at least 10 days prior to filing the plan with the city. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The following listed uses are the only main uses permitted in this district:

(1) Agricultural uses.

-- None permitted.

(2) Commercial and business service uses.

-- None permitted.

(3) Industrial uses.

-- None permitted.

(4) Institutional and community service uses.

-- None permitted.

(5) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(6) Miscellaneous uses.

-- None permitted.

(7) Office uses.

-- None permitted.

(8) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area.

(9) Residential uses.

-- Retirement housing.

(10) Retail and personal service uses.

-- None permitted.

(11) Transportation uses.

-- None permitted.

(12) Utility and public service uses.

-- None permitted.

(13) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- None permitted. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) In addition to accessory uses normally permitted with a retirement housing use, the following accessory use is permitted with the following restrictions: Resident community area: Defined as building(s) and grounds providing ancillary services to residents of this district and to residents of Area A in Planned Development District No. 568, such as a pool, dining, management’s office, maintenance, vending area, exercise area, personal service uses, and meeting areas. The resident community area must meet the following requirements:

(1) Resident community area may be located in one of more buildings that are separate from the main use.

(2) Total floor area of all resident community areas combined may not exceed 22,000 square feet. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 25 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side yard is 10 feet. Minimum rear yard is 10 feet.

(c) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units or suites is 280.

(d) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(e) Height. Minimum structure height is 40 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Minimum lot coverage is 25 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is three. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Required off-street parking in this district is 0.70 spaces per dwelling unit or suite, plus one space per 300 square feet of floor area not in a dwelling unit or suite. If more than ten off-street parking spaces are required for this use, handicapped parking must be provided pursuant to Section 51A-4.305. Off-street loading must be provided in accordance with the chart below.

Floor Area in Square Feet Total Required Spaces or Berths

0 to 50,000 None 50,000 to 100,000 1 100,000 to 300,000 2 Each additional 200,000 or fraction thereof 1 additional

(Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X standards, and tree preservation areas must be provided as shown on the conceptual plan. Trees in the tree preservation area may not be removed unless the tree threatens public health or safety as determined by a city official listed in the defenses to prosecution in Article X. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Fence,  Screening,                And      Visual       Obstruction
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.112. FENCE, SCREENING, AND VISUAL OBSTRUCTION REGULATIONS.

(a) Fence standards.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, fences must be constructed and maintained in accordance with the requirements of Section 51A-4.602.

(2) A perimeter fence must be provided as shown on the attached development plan.

(3) The perimeter fence shall be a minimum of six feet in height.

(b) Required screening.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, screening must be provided and maintained in accordance with the requirements of Section 51A-4.602.

(2) The perimeter fence may be constructed of vinyl coated chain link if it is abutting an area of natural vegetation on the Property (between the fence and the Property line) that is capable of maintaining a solid appearance.

(3) The perimeter fence on any portion of the property that is east of the point 460 feet west of the eastern boundary of the Property and south of the point 175 feet north of the southern boundary of the Property must be constructed of wrought iron and masonry columns unless it meets the requirements of Paragraph (2) above. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 25252)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25252; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25252; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-632.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 632 is located on Zoning Map Nos. M-5 and M-6. (Ord. 25252)
